import subprocess
def ref(n):
    a,b=0,1
    for _ in range(n): a,b=b,a+b
    return a
bad=[]
for n in [0,1,2,3,4,5,10,50,92,93,100,500,1000]:
    p=subprocess.run(["python3","polyglot/main.py.c",str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd="/app")
    c=subprocess.run(["./cmain",str(n)],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd="/app/polyglot")
    exp=str(ref(n))+"\n"
    ok = p.stdout==exp and c.stdout==exp and p.returncode==0 and c.returncode==0
    print(n, "OK" if ok else "FAIL", len(p.stdout), repr(c.stdout[:20]))
    if not ok: bad.append((n,repr(p.stdout),repr(c.stdout),repr(exp),p.stderr,c.stderr))
print("digits(f(1000)) =", len(str(ref(1000))))
print("FAILURES:", bad)
EOF
